title: The plastic stomatal development in grasses and its implications in crop improvement.
one_liner_zh: 综述禾本科气孔发育调控，涉及bHLH转录因子及多组学与AI数据挖掘，但核心是植物发育而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅间接相关。
abstract: Cereal crops, predominantly belonging to the grass family (Poaceae), are the cornerstone of global agriculture; thus, improving their environmental adaptability has emerged as a pivotal research focus. Stomata, which act as essential conduits mediating gas exchange and water loss in plants, are key targets for genetic modification to enhance crop drought tolerance and water use efficiency (WUE). Unlike the two-celled stomatal complexes of Arabidopsis thaliana, grasses possess four-celled stomata (two dumbbell-shaped guard cells flanked by two subsidiary cells, SCs) with distinct developmental mechanisms, which makes them critical for grasses to adapt to adverse environments. This review summarizes recent advances in understanding such species-specific developmental mechanisms in grasses, with three core emphases: Firstly, grasses possess four-celled stomatal complexes with distinct vein-proximal patterning, and plasticity of stomatal density in response to environmental stimuli (e.g., CO(2), drought stress, temperature, and light) among species; Secondly, functional characterization of key regulators (e.g., BASIC HELIX-LOOP-HELIX (bHLH) transcription factors) governing distinct stomatal developmental stages (e.g., initiation, division, differentiation), and their potential for genetic manipulation to optimize stomatal traits for improved WUE and drought resistance; Lastly, the integration of multi-omics approaches, including single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq), spatial transcriptomics (ST), pan-genomics, genome-wide association studies (GWAS), and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven data mining for accelerating the identification of novel regulators and genotype-phenotype associations in more grass crops. This review provides a comprehensive framework for understanding grass-specific stomatal development and offers actionable targets for precision breeding of drought-resilient cereal crops.
abstract_zh: 谷类作物主要属于禾本科（Poaceae），是全球农业的基石；因此，提高其环境适应性已成为关键的研究焦点。气孔作为植物中调节气体交换和水分流失的重要通道，是基因改造以增强作物耐旱性和水分利用效率（WUE）的关键靶标。与拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）的双细胞气孔复合体不同，禾本科植物具有四细胞气孔（两个哑铃形保卫细胞两侧各有一个副卫细胞，SC），其发育机制独特，这使得它们对禾本科植物适应不利环境至关重要。本综述总结了近年来在理解禾本科植物这种物种特异性发育机制方面的进展，并着重强调三个核心方面：首先，禾本科植物具有四细胞气孔复合体，其具有独特的近脉模式，且气孔密度在不同物种间对环境刺激（如CO(2)、干旱胁迫、温度和光照）表现出可塑性；其次，关键调控因子（如碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH）转录因子）在调控不同气孔发育阶段（如起始、分裂、分化）中的功能表征，以及它们通过遗传操作优化气孔性状以提高WUE和耐旱性的潜力；最后，整合多组学方法，包括单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）、空间转录组学（ST）、泛基因组学、全基因组关联研究（GWAS）以及人工智能（AI）驱动的数据挖掘，以加速在更多谷类作物中识别新型调控因子和基因型-表型关联。本综述为理解禾本科特异性气孔发育提供了全面框架，并为耐旱谷类作物的精准育种提供了可操作的靶标。
